reactor_type: showerhead type 8-in.-scale PEALD reactor (Quros Co., Plus-200)
evidence: A 2, 4, and 8 nm thick TiO2 layer was then deposited by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) at 250°C using Ti/(OC3H7)4 precursor and plasma-activated O2 reactant. One deposition cycle was composed of Ti precursor (Ti/(O-i-C3H7)4) pulse (1s) – 200 sccm Ar purge (2s) – 300 W O2 plasma gas pulse (1s) – 200 sccm Ar purge (2s).
